summary: Interpreted the read-index receipt (CheckRun d7a20d42d5b84569a0c6e4924cd577a9), which resolved all four comparisons and converts that behaviour's completing half from source-only to execution-backed: with the leader elected but nothing committed in its term the ReadIndex request produces no read state at all (index 48), the follower acknowledgement moves the leader's commit to 11 with a quorum of matches (index 49), and the released read state carries read index 11 plus the exact request context that was issued (index 50, for both the index and the identity comparison). Recorded as a Fact with its receipt, and stated the question-level account as conclusion holds with defect_claim null: the completing path is measured, the leadership-loss path that leaves a request unanswered stays source-explained and explicitly permitted by the module's own ReadIndex documentation, and the main finding is unaffected. I also carried forward the harness correction that unblocked it, noting that the earlier probes whose commit values stayed at the snapshot index did so because my delivery helper never wrote Ready entries to storage — a harness-side deficiency that no comparison in those receipts depended on. Validation passed with no execution requested.
